metadata.domain: Large Language Model / Foundation Model / AI Platform

evidence.trl_pathway: T03 at TRL 7 completing in 2 years is reasonable, and T01/T05 at TRL 6 with 2-year windows are feasible, but T02 at TRL 5 has a planned duration of 0 quarters (2030-Q1 to 2030-Q1), making its TRL progression from 5 to deployment essentially instantaneous and unrealistic.
evidence.strategic_fidelity: The declared strategy is 기술선도 (Technology Leadership), which calls for lower-TRL exploratory technologies and R&D-heavy portfolio; however, T03 at TRL 7 and T01/T05 at TRL 6 are relatively mature technologies, and only T02 at TRL 5 represents genuine exploratory investment, creating a mixed portfolio that only partially embodies the leadership strategy.
evidence.competitive_awareness: The roadmap shows no explicit articulation of competitor positioning, differentiation opportunities, or timing advantages relative to competitors; technology selections appear driven by dependency chains and market signals rather than competitive gap analysis.
evidence.market_timing: For 기술선도, completing 1-2 years before market boom is ideal, but T01 and T05 complete 2.75 years after their boom windows and T02 completes 1.5 years after its boom; only T03 achieves near-ideal preemptive timing at -1.0 year before boom, making systematic late arrival the dominant pattern.
evidence.patent_market_convergence: Technologies selected (LLM inference, distributed training, 3D generative AI) are plausible convergence-zone candidates given active patent and market activity in these areas, but there is no explicit evidence that convergence-zone targeting was intentional or methodology-driven in the selection process.

strengths: Dependency chain is correctly structured with no violations, ensuring T03 is completed before downstream technologies T01/T05 rely on it
Budget is precisely allocated with zero violation, and T03 is appropriately frontloaded as a foundational capability with high urgency scores
weaknesses: LLM 기반 컨텍스트 인식 협업 and 대규모 모델 추론 가속화 both complete 2.75 years after their market boom windows, severely undermining both technology leadership and commercial value
생성형 AI 기반 3D 공간 생성 has a zero-duration development window (2030-Q1 to 2030-Q1), indicating a planning error that makes its TRL advancement from 5 to readiness implausible
missing_technologies: Multi-agent orchestration framework (lower TRL, fits 기술선도 exploratory mandate)
Federated learning / privacy-preserving AI (aligns with distributed learning theme at earlier TRL stages)
LLM safety and alignment infrastructure (critical for foundation model leadership positioning)
investment_issues: All four technologies are classified as Strategic or High tier with no Exploratory-tier investments, which is inconsistent with a 기술선도 strategy that should include early-stage bets
T02 receives High tier investment despite having executability score of 2.0 and a zero-duration timeline, representing high financial risk with no realistic delivery plan
timing_issues: T01 (LLM 기반 컨텍스트 인식 협업) completes 2.75 years after its 2027-Q2 boom — the market window will have passed before deployment
T05 (대규모 모델 추론 가속화) also completes 2.75 years after its 2027-Q2 boom, suggesting the entire mid-tier development block was not aligned to market cadence
T02 (생성형 AI 기반 3D 공간 생성) has identical start and end dates (2030-Q1), implying no development time was allocated despite being at TRL 5
